invoicing.policy: Invoicing 2.9.0 preserves the locked Parts 1–7 baseline and completes Part 8 Customer Portal with customer-scoped expiring/revocable hashed access, customer invoice list/detail/PDF, payment and credit visibility, idempotent rate-limited customer messages and structured payment promises, operator invite/reissue/revoke/inbox workflows, portal settings, portal activity audit events, and isolated legacy single-invoice share links. Future changes must keep Invoicing, ERP integration, platform closure, app-surface, visibility, core-hardening, TypeScript, migration dry-run and production deployment gates green.
